title: Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to the acceptance of grant funding from the California Department of Social Services under the…
text:
[Council File 25-1536]
Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to the acceptance of grant funding from the California Department of Social Services under the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Local Agreement for Child Development Services Contract No. CCTR-6104 for subsidized preschool services at Department of Recreation and Parks’ licensed preschools.
(This item is referred to the Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee and Budget and Finance Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Report on accepting grant funding from the California Department of Social Services for subsidized preschool services at Department of Recreation and Parks facilities.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Oct 7, 2026)
